book.labels: a resting BUY joins the outcome's SELL side, so the passive pair cost is what a maker surface can reach. It is a cost basis, never a realized profit.

frozen_comparison.labels: a preflight that merely SUCCEEDS is not the same claim as one that AGREES; only the second licenses the envelope

authorization.labels: an authorization names an EXECUTABLE and an ENVELOPE. Editing either after review invalidates it, which is the point: approval attaches to what was read, not to a name.

recovery.budget_note: max(ledger 0, venue 0): a disagreement is always read upward

outstanding.labels: only this read releases committed cash. A cancel ack is a receipt, not a release.

window.stop_why: window withdrawn; one contract only, no continuation into the next

withdrawal.label: TERMINAL_WITHDRAWAL
withdrawal.labels: cleanup mutations are SAFETY mutations, bounded separately from the strategy budget. This path can only cancel: no place, no SELL, no crossing, no forced flatten, no change to inventory or strategy.
withdrawal.note: the venue's own open-order list is empty of this strategy's orders; FLAT ORDERS is not flat INVENTORY and says nothing about fills already taken

window.why: the venue's own open-order list is empty of this strategy's orders; FLAT ORDERS is not flat INVENTORY and says nothing about fills already taken

inventory.labels: matched-pair economics, directional-residual P&L, fees, rebates and settlement cashflow are accounted SEPARATELY and never summed into one number. Nothing here is REALIZED: a cost basis is not a profit and settlement has not paid.

window.residual_note: any residual is CARRIED directional exposure, reconciled through settlement. No taker cross was introduced to flatten it.
window.inert_note: FLAT ORDERS is not flat INVENTORY. inert:false means at least one strategy-owned order may still be executable; inert:true means the venue showed none resting and says nothing about fills already taken.
window.realized_note: REALIZED stays null until a venue-confirmed cash movement is read back. settlement_report keeps matched-pair and directional-residual apart.

refresh_link.note: reads are attributed by each refresh's own reconcile_attempts; any read after the last refresh belongs to terminal withdrawal

unreadable_reasons: CROSSED book: a bid at or above its own ask
book_capture.labels: a cycle with no readable presented book is a cycle the controller quoted nothing in; UNREADABLE is recorded, never replaced with an empty book.

decision_capture.note: EVIDENCE ONLY. Each wrapper makes the same call with the same arguments, returns the same object and propagates every exception. It adds no decision, no mutation and no bound; every limit is still enforced inside ws_continuous.Driver. The driver now RETURNS the market state it decided on, which moved its executable_sha -- an additive key nothing reads back, not a change to what it decides.

place_ack_note: OBSERVED, not inferred: each ack below is the venue's own reply recorded at the socket seam, with credential-shaped values redacted and key names and types preserved. An empty list means no order.place was ever sent.

strike_check.why: not settled yet, or no strike published

resolution.labels: the OUTCOME leg only. A settled contract says what it resolved to, never what our account received; realized P&L still requires authenticated cash reconciliation. UNCONFIRMED means no read showed a settlement, NOT that none occurred.
